summary: Comprehensive test suite with strong unit test coverage (all module functions tested) and well-designed integration tests via act. Excellent coverage of conventional commit types (feat→minor, fix→patch, breaking→major), version file formats (VERSION and package.json), and changelog generation. Good edge case testing (whitespace, v prefix, scopes, breaking change tokens, precedence). However, integration tests depend on fixture files (feat.log, fix.log, breaking.log, none.log) that are referenced but not shown in the provided code, creating brittleness. Also assumes Docker availability and a pre-built act image. Unit tests are highly trustworthy; integration tests are well-designed but have environmental dependencies that could cause CI fragility.
